title: RAL Mirror Bug
description: Diagnose and fix a frozen RAL mirror caused by a missing predictor connection in connect_phase.

steps.title: Step 1: Identify the Frozen Mirror
steps.instructions: Run the simulation. Every `mirror(UVM_CHECK)` call fails with the stale reset value `0x0000`, even though bus writes to the DUT succeed.

steps.title: Step 2: Trace the Predictor Pipeline
steps.instructions: Open `testbench_buggy.sv` and inspect `connect_phase()`. The predictor and adapter are assigned, but is the bus monitor's analysis port connected to `predictor.bus_in`?

steps.title: Step 3: Fix the Connect Phase
steps.instructions: Add `axi_agt.monitor.ap.connect(predictor.bus_in);` to `connect_phase`. Re-run. The mirror should now track writes and `mirror(UVM_CHECK)` should pass.
